crm_consent_event_evidence.name: crm_consent_event_evidence
crm_consent_event_evidence.value: "crm_consent_events"."source" not in ('AGENT_VERBAL','IMPORT') or "crm_consent_events"."evidence_ref" is not null

crm_player_rg_flags_expiry_idx.name: crm_player_rg_flags_expiry_idx
crm_player_rg_flags_expiry_idx.where: status = 'ACTIVE' and ends_at is not null

crm_tasks_dedupe_key.name: crm_tasks_dedupe_key
crm_tasks_dedupe_key.where: dedupe_key is not null and status in ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','BLOCKED')

crm_tasks_sweep_idx.name: crm_tasks_sweep_idx
crm_tasks_sweep_idx.where: acknowledged_at is null and status in ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS')
